# Luban documentation

> Current Luban game configuration documentation. Historical versions are excluded.

Schema is a contract. Register tables explicitly or through the default # filename importer. Use matching code/data targets and runtimes.
Validate with -f --strict without output targets before generating. Enable text/path dependencies explicitly.
Main CLI diagnostics use stderr; Agent returns one stdout JSON. Schema export alone does not validate data.
